items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: So Sonny, you know how Sonny talk and says, man, when you going to give us a raise... Give it to Duke. And that's when Duke took over... he had Otto Hardwick, he went up to the Cotton Club... The band would play in the theatre

ctx.x: It might have been the Kit Kat.
No, not the Kit Kat, it was some other club and this guy Sonny Greer and the guitar player had the band.
